comment: Sketch1 on XY for deleting, trimming and freeing sketch patterns (mitcad#2007): two free points that frame the view's fit at (-40, -30) and (40, 30) (p1, p2); a line c3 from (-30, -20) to (-20, -20) in a rectangular pattern of 4 along x, 15 mm apart (copies from (-15, -20), (0, -20) and (15, -20)); a line c6 from (25, 15) to (30, 15) in a circular pattern of 4 about (20, 15); and a line c9 from (5, -25) to (5, -15) across the second copy of c3.
